title: AM Bench 2025 AMB2025-03: high-cycle rotating bending fatigue of PBF-L Ti-6Al-4V with pre-test XCT of whole gauge sections and killer-pore registration

chemistry.notes: Measured solid chemistry of 800VAC-85 specimen; 800HIP-106 measured Al 6.30, V 3.89, O 0.10, Fe 0.16 (AMB2025-03 description document).

processing.route: L-PBF (PBF-L) + HIP or vacuum heat treatment
processing.parameters: 3D Systems DMP Flex 350; 60 um layer, 80 um spot, 245 W, 1250 mm/s, 245 deg scan rotation between layers, no baseplate preheat, 99.999% Ar; plasma-atomized powder 10-45 um (D10 21, D50 35, D90 47 um). Vertically built cylinders ~15 mm dia x 105 mm.
processing.heat_treatment: 800HIP: 800 C / 2 h / 200 MPa Ar, ~12 C/min cooling. 800VAC: same thermal cycle in vacuum furnace with ~75 mTorr Ar partial pressure (porosity retained).
processing.surface_condition: Machined and polished per ISO 1143 (Ra ~0.09-0.13 um, all < 0.2 um).

acquisition.facility: Lab Zeiss Xradia Versa XRM-500 (140 kV, 71 uA, 4 s exposure, 1601 projections, HE2 filter)
acquisition.volume_dimensions: Entire RBF gauge section, 4 stitched FOVs; typically >3200 slices of ~1004x1024 px per specimen
acquisition.notes: XCT done before fatigue on five RBF specimens; lead-particle lacquer fiducial used to register XCT to fractography and identify the killer pore. Raw .txrm/.xrm, 16-bit stitched reconstructions, denoised 8-bit stacks, segmentations, labelled pore stacks, VTK models and per-pore CSV (centroid, volume, ESD, sphericity, bounding box) provided; processed with IMPPY3D.

microstructure.grain_size_um: alpha-lath area avg 25.06 um^2 (800VAC) and 24.13 um^2 (800HIP) from 2D EBSD
microstructure.texture: 2D EBSD texture maps provided (build-direction influence still evident)

defects.statistics: Per-pore CSV metrics and porosity CSV per specimen; sqrt(area) measurements of killer defects in answer data (sqrt_area_measurements.pdf).

mechanical_properties.other: Averages of 3 ASTM E8 tests, 800VAC. 800HIP: YS 1004.8, UTS 1089.5 MPa, E 153 GPa, total elong. 19.4%, uniform elong. 5.2%. No statistically significant difference between conditions.

fatigue.loading: Four-point rotating bending (ISO 1143), R = -1, 100 Hz, ADMET eXpert 9313; 24 specimens per condition
fatigue.results: S-N data for both conditions provided (800HIP as calibration data, 800VAC released in answers_data).
fatigue.crack_initiation: 800HIP: no initiation at pores (surface initiation confirmed by SEM fractography). 800VAC: pore-initiated failures; killer pores identified in XCT via fiducial registration and SEM/optical fractography (challenge CHAL-AMB2025-03-FL asked participants to predict killer-pore feature IDs).

data_availability.size: ~239 GB total (raw XCT ~166 GB, XCT analysis ~30 GB, EBSD ~36 GB, answers XCT/fractography registration ~5.8 GB)
data_availability.format: Zeiss .txrm/.xrm, TIFF stacks, VTK, CSV, XLSX, ANG/OSC EBSD

references.citation: Hrabe N., Benzing J., Moser N., Derimow N., Kafka O., Saville A., et al., AMB2025-03 High-Cycle Rotating Bending Fatigue Tests of PBF-L Ti-6Al-4V (dataset/challenge description), NIST 2025
Moser N.H., Kafka O.L., Landauer A.K., IMPPY3D: 3D X-ray Computed Tomography Image Processing in Python, NIST 2023

notes: Benchmark explicitly designed for specimen-specific fatigue strength and crack-initiation-location prediction from XCT pore data. Answer key (fatigue for both conditions, residual stress, XCT-fractography registration) now published in the same record.

processing.heat_treatment: As-built plus 14 heat treatments (stress relief, sub- and super-transus HIP variants with different cooling rates, rapid quench, tempering; e.g. HT2 nsHIP, HT3 csHIP, HT10 csHIP+FC, HT13 SHIP); three conditions down-selected for RBF (HT4, HT10, HT14 per fractography folders).

fatigue.results: Highest runout stress for the lowest-temperature sub-transus HIP (800 C, 2 h, 200 MPa); super-transus treatment reduced fatigue strength (IJF 2024).
fatigue.crack_initiation: RBF fractography (SEM) provided for HT4, HT10, HT14; initiation linked to microstructure (large prior-beta grains, GB alpha) after porosity closure.

title: L-PBF IN718 as-built surfaces with 0-2 contour passes: XCT surface/porosity data and rotating beam HCF (NIST)

processing.parameters: Vertical specimens; only the number of contour passes varied (giving three as-built roughness levels) vs. polished reference; build CAD and parameters in dataset.

acquisition.notes: Analysis files labelled '30um' (e.g. *_30um_surf_roughness.csv, *_30um_sv3d.csv) suggest ~30 um effective voxel (unverified).
